_title: humaniq: admin settings, roles and sign-in
_note: What you see: Admin settings (settings chrome): tabs Roles and permissions (HR, payroll, manager and employee groups, field-level access), Sign-in (DigiD or Yivi for the external portal, SSO, password policy, lockout), Notifications (notification rules on or off), Audit trail.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Admin settings (settings chrome): tabs Rollen en rechten (HR, salaris, leidinggevende, medewerker groups, field-level access), Inloggen (DigiD/Yivi for external portal, SSO, password policy, lockout), Meldingen (notification rules on/off), Audittrail.

Every role is linked to a Nextcloud group. Whoever is in the group gets the role.
medewerkers, contracten, verlof, verzuim: employees, contracts, leave, sick leave, GDPR requests
salarisruns berekenen en goedkeuren, aan: calculate and approve payroll runs, tax returns, payments
eigen team: verlof, uren en gesprekken g: own team: approve leave, hours and reviews
eigen gegevens, loonstroken, verlof en d: own details, payslips, leave and expense claims
Verberg salaris, BSN en bankgegevens voo: Hide salary, BSN and bank details from roles that do not need them.
OpenRegister verbergt een veld voor wie: OpenRegister hides a field from anyone who may not see it, also in exports, search results and the API.
Hoe medewerkers, sollicitanten en oud-me: How employees, applicants and former employees sign in, and what happens after failed attempts.
